description: Create nonclustered index with INCLUDE columns
body:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE name='IX_$table$_$columns$_INCLUDES' AND object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.$table$'))
    DROP INDEX IX_$table$_$columns$_INCLUDES ON dbo.$table$
GO

CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_$table$_$columns$_INCLUDES
ON dbo.$table$($CURSOR$)
INCLUDE();
GO
